sentences.text: Today no one appeared on behalf of the applicant, however, Sri Dharmendra Kumar, counsel for the applicant appearing in Application u/s 528 BNSS No.6259 of 2025, filed by the present applicant,
has submitted that the parties have settled the dispute amicably and entered into a written compromise.

6. In view of above, the present application is dismissed as not pressed.
